rationale: With only 10 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the close, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that gapped down significantly from prior close ($12.01 to current $11.31) and is trading in a narrow consolidation range with very low per-candle volume (sub-5000 shares). The ATR of $0.06 on 5-minute bars is too small relative to spread and execution risk to generate a meaningful risk/reward in the remaining time, and the broader market stress (SPY -1.83%, VIXY +10%) adds directional uncertainty that makes a forced-close position inadvisable.
